bottleneck: RE-FRAMED 2026-10-08 (Day-8 review). The earlier binding constraint (channel/audience fit — Coconala 公開依頼's pool wrong for an honest solo-AI provider) is now LARGELY RESOLVED: the first CrowdWorks scan (10/08 13:26 JST) pulled 1,142 listings / ~25 fit / 2 GO on day 1 vs Coconala's ~67 screened / 1 GO over 7 days — the request-board model fits the proposal motion. The binding constraint has MOVED to two things: (1) a RUNTIME-PERMISSION send-block — the Mac's Claude auto-mode classifier blocks typing into the CrowdWorks 応募 form, so 0 of 2 GO drafts went out (owner-crowdworks-proposal-permission filed; owner must paste the drafts or whitelist unattended submission); and (2) an UNPROVEN REPLY RATE for a 0-review seller (5 Coconala proposals -> 0 replies). The fix is to clear the send-block and run CrowdWorks at the 5/day cap under the price_plus_reply selection (¥10-15k early-applicant jobs + free sample), the lever with the highest P(G2). X and passive stores stay low-effort/zero-effort; they are not the constraint.
bottleneck_ja: G1失敗(10/07確定)後に改訂。販売動作（ココナラ提案）は動いているが、供給プール（公開依頼）の構造的ミスマッチで律速。7日で~67件超を審査しGOは1件・返信0。公開依頼はイラスト/音楽/動画/声など創作が大半（自動化レーン外）、数少ない適格案件も多年の人間実績要求（虚偽禁止=PG-1条件4に抵触）かAI中心の応募を明確に拒否（依頼5310341）。律速は『チャネル/客層の適合性（公開依頼の母集団が誠実なAI単独提供者に合わない）』＋『自前の流入が皆無（X極小・プロフクリック0、ストア流入0）』。打ち手は投稿増やストア再構築ではなく、適合する公開依頼の供給拡大（ココナラGO基準の拡張＋より大量の依頼ボード追加）。
